No sibling in this epic is dispatched. `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh --status` read `lock is free`, `queue: empty` ⇒ arrival depth 1, below `LOCK_DEPTH_HOLD`.

### Why `Clause-②: no`

Adding a unit to an existing key's `.describe()` adds **no key**, **no export**, and changes **no validation outcome** — an input that parsed before parses identically after. That is the text-face criterion in `references/lanes/spec.md` (*"改动前过校验的输入改动后同判 ⇒ 文本面"*), and the text face's changeset is `patch`.

⚠️ **The declaration does not clear the enqueue gate, and this claim does not pretend it does.** The clause-② enqueue gate has two legs and the **path leg fires on this card regardless of the declaration** — `--tier` names all three files as `packages/spec/src/**`, *"the contract surface … the normal landing zone of a clause-② card"*. So an in-seat clause-② review record is owed on the PR or this card **before** it may turn ready or enqueue. That review is scheduled, not waived.

⚠️ If the round's actual diff ends up adding a key, an export, or moving an accept/reject outcome, this declaration is wrong: **stop and report**. ⛔ Do not edit this line, and ⛔ do not proceed on the theory that a standing `no` is cheap.

### Why this card is first of the seven

It is the only one of the seven that needs **no rename** — the three keys already carry their unit in the key name; only the `.describe()` an author or an AI actually reads is missing. ⇒ ⛔ no ADR-0087 conversion, ⛔ no tombstone, ⛔ no published-key rename, ⛔ no `objectui` pin sweep, ⛔ no contention for the generated migration registry. It validates the whole pipeline (claim → PR → in-seat contract review → enqueue → land) at the lowest possible blast radius before the six rename cards start queueing behind one generated file.

## ACCEPT — PR #17953

Epic PM for the #15939 subtree, `session_015c5G6TmpMKgnusmTpD7Ntt`, 2026-09-13T08:49Z. Checked against GitHub, ⛔ not against the round's own account of itself.

### Checklist conclusion

| item | reading (taken by this seat) |
|:--|:--|
| PR shape | draft, base `main`, first body line `Fixes #17786`, `mergeable_state: clean` |
| every check green | **33 success + 2 skipped, 0 incomplete, 0 red** across 35 distinct names at head `eac52ecb7b` — the whole set, ⛔ not the required subset. Legacy `Vercel` status success |
| clause-② enqueue gate, limb ② | `check-clause2-carriers --pair 17953` → **exit 0**, run by me |
| clause-② enqueue gate, limb ① | in-seat contract review **PASS** at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, posted on the PR ([`5652234845`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/17953#issuecomment-5652234845)); served tier verified from the harness-stamped transcript at 152 × `claude-fable-5-1`, zero other values, against a 189 × `claude-opus-5` discriminating control |
| path face | `get_files`, ⛔ not the report: 7 paths, **zero governed** (`docs/adr/**`, `.claude/**`, `skills/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`) ⇒ ordinary landing |
| scope | exactly the three declared sites, their three generated mirrors, one changeset. Nothing else under `content/docs/` moved |
| changeset | owed and present, `patch` — and *measured* rather than assumed, with a shipping positive control, a non-shipping negative control and a dark control |

### Spot checks that were worth taking

- The round reported 100 gate families derived, 98 run, **2 declared NOT MEASURED** (both blocked on a whole-repo build that is CI's `Build Core`), 0 unrun. Five gates that first *refused* (exit 3/1) were not counted as passes — the prerequisites were built and the gates re-run, including a `git fetch` of an unreachable pinned fixture commit that a shallow clone could not see. "未测量不是通过" was applied, not merely quoted.
- The independent review found one thing the round did not name: `json-schema/kernel/PluginLoadingEvent.json` gains a `"description"` **annotation** key. It judged this a JSON-Schema annotation on the schema document rather than a key on the accepted payload — so not clause-② — and recorded it rather than leaving it to be rediscovered. That is the review earning its cost.
- It also corrected the round on the letter of one sweep sentence (`Duration in milliseconds` does occur at `packages/observability/src/perf-timing.ts:43,60`, an unrelated JSDoc) while confirming the substance. No action.

### Deviations — both accepted, and the surface one is mine

1. **Declared file-surface breach**: three regenerated `content/docs/references/**` pages beyond the dispatched surface. Accepted. `check:generated` named this artefact and *only* this artefact stale (1 of 15), `gen:docs` output is byte-identical to what was committed, and 产物随源走 puts a regenerated references page with the source PR that triggered it. ⛔ Not scope creep — **my dispatch order's surface line was incomplete**, which the independent review reached separately ("the dispatch's surface list was incomplete, not the PR"). Same root cause as the consumer/generated-artefact list I had to send mid-round: two omissions from one order.
2. The round declined to attach `needs:contract-review` and said so. Correct, and load-bearing — that label is a clause-② affirmative carrier to `check-changeset-no-major` and would have forced this non-widening change to `minor`. ⇒ ⛔ deliberately not hung here.

### Next

Turning ready and enqueuing. The merge queue is the only recognised landing path. This card does not touch `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts`, so it does not queue behind the six rename siblings.
